fixtures: Swift sources copied into data/. Runs are read-only, so fixes are shown in the answer rather than written.

evals.name: review-repo-sync
evals.prompt: Users say a sync sometimes does nothing, and the branch list is randomly empty right after launch. Review data/swift-sync/ (RepoSync and its tests) and show me the fixed code.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses the try? calls on connect, listBranches and pull as the reason failures are silent ('does nothing'): each must be do/catch with the error logged (the Logger is already there) and surfaced in model state, not swallowed. The Task.sleep after an unawaited connect is a race workaround: await connect() directly (or signal readiness) instead of sleeping. DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter mixed with async/await is replaced by plain async code on the main actor. BranchCache is shared mutable state across tasks: make it an actor (or main-actor confined), and drop nonisolated(unsafe) on the global. Tests: names follow test<Subject>_<Condition>_<ExpectedResult>, async tests are async (throws) with no XCTestExpectation, no Task.sleep waits, and the fake is created in setUp() and released in tearDown() rather than in a property initializer.
assertions: Identifies the try? calls as why failures are silent, and replaces them with do/catch that logs and surfaces the error
Replaces the Task.sleep wait for connect with awaiting connect() (or an explicit readiness signal), calling the sleep a race workaround
Replaces DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter with async/await code rather than keeping GCD
Makes BranchCache an actor (or confines it to the main actor) and removes nonisolated(unsafe) from the shared global
Renames the tests to the test<Subject>_<Condition>_<ExpectedResult> form, e.g. testLoad_WhenConnected_PublishesBranches
Rewrites testLoad as an async test without XCTestExpectation
Removes the Task.sleep wait from testPull
Moves the FakeGitClient fixture out of the property initializer into setUp(), released in tearDown()

evals.name: tests-for-token-store
evals.prompt: Write the XCTest tests for data/TokenStore.swift.
evals.expected_output: An XCTestCase whose test names follow test<Subject>_<Condition>_<ExpectedResult> (e.g. testToken_WhenExpired_ReturnsRefreshedToken, testToken_ForUnknownAccount_ThrowsNotFound). Tests are async throws functions that await the actor, with no XCTestExpectation. Shared fixtures (a fixed clock, a recording refresher) are created in setUp() and released in tearDown(), not in property initializers. Expiry is driven by the injected now closure, not by sleeping.
assertions: Every test name has three underscore-separated parts in the form test<Subject>_<Condition>_<ExpectedResult>
Tests are async functions that await the actor, with no XCTestExpectation
The TokenStore and the refresher fixture are built in setUp() and released in tearDown(), not in property initializers or rebuilt inline in each test
Expiry is controlled through the injected now clock, with no Task.sleep or real waiting
Covers the unknown-account case throwing TokenStoreError.notFound
Covers an expired token being refreshed and the fresh token being stored for the next call
